key_insight: MedUIGym enables training and evaluation of clinical GUI agents, revealing persistent workflow difficulties while showing gains from task-based training.
engineering_relevance: Its paired GUI and native-tool interfaces over identical clinical data support comparisons of interface-dependent agent performance.
method: Unify 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families.
Run agents through screenshot observations and mouse-and-keyboard actions, verifying answers and required clinical actions.
Collect parallel GUI trajectories for offline learning and support online reinforcement learning from task rewards.
evidence_signal: Evaluation of 12 vision-language models found inconsistent gains from increased reasoning effort; both trained Qwen3.5 models improved on in-domain tasks and generalized to external-source tasks.
watch_item: Benchmark improvements do not establish safety or reliability in live clinical EHR deployments.
paper_title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
